# The A.V. Club

> > Pop culture criticism and entertainment journalism covering film, television, music, gaming, and the intersection of media with technology and politics.

The A.V. Club delivers sharp cultural commentary through reviews, news, and features spanning horror films, streaming platforms, video games, and contemporary entertainment. The site covers major entertainment entities like Netflix, Warner Bros., and figures including Maggie Gyllenhaal, Christian Bale, and Guillermo del Toro.

## Key Topics

- Film reviews and criticism
- Netflix original content
- Horror and monster movies
- Frankenstein adaptations
- Warner Bros. Discovery
- Streaming platform news
- Video game reviews
- Entertainment industry news
- The Bride! (Maggie Gyllenhaal film)
- Government surveillance and privacy
- 2026 film releases
- Beat-'em-up games
- Toronto entertainment scene
- The Daily Wire productions
- Celebrity casting announcements
